entities.summary: John Turek is an American retired professional basketball player. Standing at 6 ft 9 in, Turek used to play as power forward or center. He played collegiately for the Nebraska Cornhuskers and continued his career as a professional player in Europe. Turek played for teams based in the Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, Germany and France.
